Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`)... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.

independent_computation.step_1_what_the_leaf_is: exact_sources is timeline_coverage's list of damage sources carrying authored (exact) event timing; the companion list is coarse_sources (sources with no authored event timing, e.g. muramana_ability / proc_Eclipse per data/worklists/e9-bis-b-task.md). For a Syndra fight the ability sources are the four keys Q, W, E, R.
independent_computation.step_2_effective_cooldowns_at_60: Reading the '60' in the scenario id as the config's ability haste (level cap is 20, so 60 is not a level), and applying cd' = cd*100/(100+AH) to the cached cooldown rows at max ranks: W r5 = 8*100/160 = 5.000 s; E r5 = 15*100/160 = 9.375 s; R r3 = 80*100/160 = 50.000 s. Q is the exception: its cached cooldown carries affectedByCdr = false, so the 60 AH does not touch it; only R's own passive haste does, giving Q r5 = 7*100/(100+30) = 5.385 s at R rank 3. Under either reading of '60' (60 AH or a 60 s window) R is cast exactly once - both because 50 s >= the rotation window and because math-foundations L462 pins 'R casts exactly once per timed fight' as a model constraint. R is therefore the one source that appears exactly once, and it is the terminal entry of the cast order.
independent_computation.step_3_R_must_be_cast_last: The cached R text is explicit that R's damage is a function of how many Dark Spheres are already alive: 3 conjured + up to 4 grabbed live ones. At rank 3 the cached leveling rows give minimum 480 (+60% AP) for the 3 self-conjured spheres and maximum 1120 (+140% AP) for all 7, i.e. the 4 pre-existing spheres are worth 4 * (160 + 20% AP). At 600 AP: min = 480 + 360 = 840; max = 1120 + 840 = 1960 - a 2.33x swing (+1120 raw magic damage) purely from having cast the sphere generators first. Q's spheres persist 6 s on the ground and W refreshes a grabbed sphere's duration, so Q/W/E all precede R in any correct Syndra rotation. Consequently, in any ordering of exact_sources that carries cast/event order, R is the last of the four ability sources and W is not.
independent_computation.step_4_reading_the_two_candidate_values: The OLD value is exactly what an order-blind list yields: sorted({Q,W,E,R}) = [E, Q, R, W], whose index 3 is 'W'. That list is invariant to the cast order - it would print the same string for every possible ordering, which makes it vacuous for a scenario whose entire identity is 'custom_order'. The NEW value 'R' at the final index is what an order-bearing list must show, and it agrees with step 3 (R last) and step 2 (R single-cast, longest effective cooldown by an order of magnitude: 50 s vs 5.0-9.4 s).
independent_computation.step_5_conclusion: R at index 3 is the correct terminal ability source for a Syndra rotation. 'W' at that position would mean W was scheduled after R, which the cached R text contradicts (it would forfeit up to 4 * (160 + 20% AP) = 1120 magic damage at 600 AP).

residual_uncertainty: The scenario's declared cast order lives in scripts/golden_snapshot.py, which this runbook forbids reading, so index 3 could not be confirmed positionally against a declared order; nor could the exact length of exact_sources (whether the four ability keys are the only entries) be confirmed from data/ alone. The verdict rests on two things that ARE derivable from the permitted evidence: (a) the old value is precisely the alphabetical sort of Syndra's four ability keys, i.e. an order-free artifact, and (b) the cached wiki text makes R the single-cast, last-in-rotation source. If exact_sources is intended to be a sorted set rather than an ordered timeline list, the leaf is order-free and the index carries no meaning - but then the scenario name has no referent. Under the order-bearing reading, which is the only one under which this leaf is meaningful, the new value is correct.
